amends: incumbent_efficiency_stage0/stage1 preregistrations (61156fc5, d76b6671) and the scale_boundedness_wave (872206dd)
inspection_scope: training-resource telemetry only (peak per-GPU memory, per-epoch wall time, num_parameters) extracted from already-committed lanes; no new accuracy numbers were read
change: Defect-4 comparisons are re-framed from matched PARAMETERS to matched RESOURCES, per Peter 2026-08-08: the binding constraints are peak training VRAM, training throughput/wall-clock, and scalability headroom -- parameter count is a proxy that this amendment demotes to descriptive.
immediate_implications_declared: On resource axes the incumbent's lead is far larger than the parameter frame suggested: 7.7x less peak VRAM and 3.6x less wall-clock than even the 784k flagship, 22x less VRAM and 3.9x less wall-clock than the matched-parameter rung, while holding the accuracy lead.
The rung's actual parameter count is 11.4M, not the ~9.6M the stage-1 prereg estimated; recorded here.
The E1 1.42x 'gap at matched parameters' remains true but is no longer the deciding frame; accuracy-per-VRAM and accuracy-per-wall-clock frontiers become primary for the defect-4 road decision.

The mechanism question sharpens: the soft-slice exchange delivers accuracy in a ~5 GB / 0.13 s-step envelope; MT's kernel-attention activation footprint is the resource bottleneck. 'Absorb the mechanism' must mean absorbing the EFFICIENCY, not just the accuracy.
planned_analyses_no_new_training: accuracy vs peak-VRAM and accuracy vs train-wall-clock frontiers from existing lanes (flagship, x2h, x2l4h, x2l8h, gt_small, gt) once the window's lanes complete

scalability-headroom statement: at 10k-cell resolution GT has ~50x VRAM headroom on GB300, MT rung ~2.5x; resolution-scaling of memory to be measured from the sweep evals' telemetry rather than asserted
gates_unchanged: all registered gates keep their letter; the ROAD DECISION criteria (mechanism hunt vs incumbent-wins statement) will be argued on resource-normalized frontiers with the parameter frame reported alongside
